record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 MoME assigns image-modality expertise with hierarchical gating; MoME+ adds soft input routing for missing/combined MRI modalities. It evaluates nine lesion datasets and reports performance comparable to multiple task-specific nnU-Nets with simpler model management/deployment. This is medical segmentation rather than LLM expert parallelism or inference serving, so the MoE-family connection is conceptual.
record.title: A Foundation Model for Lesion Segmentation on Brain MRI With Mixture of Modality Experts
